---
description: Build Phase 6 — Order Entry on the P2 kernel, the P4 partner documents and the P5 stock ledger: item lines on AR/AP documents with COGS and returns, sales and purchase orders with derived commitment and on-order quantities, backorders, kits (Breakup), GRNs against a GRN accrual control account, supplier-invoice matching with price variance, and landed cost (Importation Split) into item cost; the accrual account is zero when fully matched and the landed-cost clearing account is zero when fully allocated
---
Implement **Phase 6** as specified in `docs/Vinea_ERP_Master_Plan_v5.md` §5 (P6), ADR-05 (the event vocabulary: `GoodsReceived`, `SupplierInvoiceMatched`, `StockSold`), §B.1 (the Sage GRV two-step flow — *Receive Stock* then *Process Invoice*), §B.2 (Importation Split) and Appendix C (navigation contract: Order defaults, GRV, Purchase order, Sales order, Breakup).

Order Entry adds **no third ledger**. Orders are commitments, not postings: a sales or purchase order writes no journal entry and no stock move, and every quantity it "holds" — committed, on order, backordered, received, invoiced, matched — is derived from lines by query, never stored as a running column. The only new postings in this phase are stock moves through the P5 primitives and partner-document entries through the P4 service. If you find yourself writing `quantity_received += …` on a purchase-order line, stop — that is the v4 design this rebuild exists to delete.

Two mandatory **STOP for owner approval** gates: after step 2 and after step 5. Report and wait for an explicit go-ahead. Never continue past a report on a "Continue to iterate?" prompt. Every step starts from a pulled `main` on its own branch (`p6-step-N`); no step is stacked on the previous step's branch. Every step report ends with `git status --short` and `git log @{u}..` both empty, quoted.

Where the plan leaves a choice open, decide, implement, and list it under "Decisions worth review" in that step's report, as P1–P5 did.

## Preconditions (already built — consume, never re-implement)

- **Tenancy and auth (P1):** httpOnly cookie sessions, `CompanyMembership`, every tenant table `ENABLE` + `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` with `FOR ALL` policies carrying `WITH CHECK`, RLS linter tests, audited service calls with a real `actor`, dev as non-superuser `vinea_app`, migrations through `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL` only, `make migrate-check` on an empty scratch database (DDL proof only — rule 10).
- **Ledger kernel (P2):** PostingEngine is the only GL writer. Journal lines are signed amounts with dimensions including `item_id` and `partner_id` — use them, add no parallel column. Gapless `document_sequences` with the claimant registry in `app/kernel/sequences.py` (`SEQUENCE_CLAIMANTS`: a new doc type registers its claimants or the gapless check fails); `DEFAULT_PREFIXES` in the same file. Half-up rounding to `currency.decimal_places` (RWF = 0), dated `exchange_rates`, immutability triggers, frozen-base reversals, `assert_ledger_invariants`.
- **Subledger (P4):** `partners` with `is_customer` / `is_supplier`; `partner_documents` / `partner_document_lines` with `DOCUMENT_MATRIX` (role × kind → doc type, control sign, transaction type), `LineInput` / `DocumentInput`, per-line tax half-up in document currency with the document-level `tax_mode`, credit-limit check at post, `Idempotency-Key`, `reverse_document`, allocations with realized FX, `assert_subledger_invariants`. P4 decision 11 kept the line table extensible and item-free — P6 is the phase that adds the item shape. The control-account guard is the `control_account_modules` `(module, control_type)` registry enforced in the engine **and** by DB trigger (VN007) with the dimension-required check (VN008) — a new control type is a registry row plus a `ControlType` value, not a new mechanism.
- **Stock ledger (P5):** `stock_moves` append-only; `stock_balances` / `item_cost_state` as verifiable caches; weighted average per item per company in posting order with the flush rule and the negative-stock policy; `receive_stock()`, `issue_stock()`, `revalue_stock()`, `transfer_stock()`, `reverse_stock_posting()` in `app/inventory/stock.py`, taking `StockDocument` (doc type, date, source links, idempotency) and `StockLine` (item, warehouse, base-unit quantity, `unit_cost` on receipts, frozen `value`, `contra_account_id`, `project_id`, `source_line_id`). `StockPosting.keyed_moves` is the line→move map (never count positions in `moves`). `masters.to_base_quantity()` converts any UoM of the item's category; `GET /inventory/items/lookup` resolves code or barcode. Items already carry `cogs_account_id`, `sales_account_id`, `default_sales_tax_code_id`, `default_purchase_tax_code_id`, `selling_price`, `price_includes_tax` — data seeded for this phase, unused until now. `gl_settings.cogs_account_id` is seeded and unread. The in-transit warehouse is never selectable on a document. `posting.module_reversal(module)`: a module-owned entry (`inv`, `ar`, `ap`) is reversed only through its module's service. `assert_stock_invariants`. Every INV line carries `item_id` and has exactly one move.
- **Kernel event stubs:** `GoodsReceived`, `SupplierInvoiceMatched` and `StockSold` in `app/kernel/events.py` are `_StubEvent`s that `post()` rejects with `unsupported_event`. The vocabulary is ADR-05's; the classes are placeholders. Decision 13 below says what replaces them.
- **Frontend (P3–P5):** tokens and primitives, the shell rendering the Appendix C tree with later phases phase-tagged, `DocumentWorkspace` + `LineGrid` (keyboard model parametrised across all navigable columns — keep it that way for the item, UoM and warehouse columns), batch mode, IndexedDB drafts keyed by draft UUID as `Idempotency-Key`, inline `field_errors`, next-intl with every string externalised, `formatMoney`, `todayIso` / `monthToDateIso` in `lib/format.ts` (never `toISOString().slice(0, 10)`), frontend enum values generated from the Python enums (`frontend/src/lib/api-enums.ts` via `backend/app/scripts/export_api_enums.py` — a new enum is regenerated, never typed), the "Include zero balances" convention, posting preview before Post, print layouts and CSV, Playwright e2e on `docker compose` with `E2E_PASSWORD` from env on a reset database (`make db-reset` → Rugari Wines E2E, Kivu Traders E2E), `axe` in CI.
- **Process rules, standing:** a screen is not done until a test has opened it with data and a committed screenshot shows rows (rule 13); every screen's e2e asserts one formatted money value and one formatted quantity read off the page (P5 approvals, condition 4); every mutating endpoint has a caller under `frontend/src` or a `by design` / `GAP (<phase>)` reason in the rule-14 allow-file — a P6 endpoint gets its caller by step 8, not an exemption; every regression test is proven sensitive by reverting the fix; delegated verification attaches raw command output; depth passes (fresh-DB e2e, deep property runs) belong at steps 2, 5 and 9 only; `make be-lint && make be-test` run in the backend container; `gh` hangs in the agent's shell — open PRs through the REST API with `curl`, never merge them.
- **Before step 1 — say which in the step-1 report:** (a) PR #31 (`p5-step-9`) is merged and README on `main` reads "Phase 5 complete"; (b) `/ar/documents`, `/ap/documents` and their detail screens carrying **Reverse**, plus **Unallocate** on the allocation screens, are on `main` — the P5 final report's "first item after P5". P6 adds item lines and a companion stock entry to exactly those documents; their reversal path exists and is e2e-tested before a single item line is added. If (b) is not on `main`, it is the first PR of this phase, before step 1.
- **Before step 6 — say which in the step-5 report:** issue #30 (the `toISOString()` sweep with its lint guard) and the P1 screens the rule-14 register lists as `GAP (P1)` (password reset, email verification, invitation accept and revoke). If either is still open, it is the first PR before any P6 screen — P6 adds roles a second user has to be invited into.

## Out of scope — do not build

Quotations and pro-formas; requisitions, approvals or order workflows; delivery notes, picking, packing or partial *shipment* as separate documents (the invoice is the delivery, as in Evolution); back-to-back and drop-ship orders; sales price lists and purchase price history (one `selling_price`; purchase prices are keyed on the PO); multi-level kits, kit assembly or disassembly into stock (P12 — a kit here is a virtual bundle exploded at order time); serial, batch or lot tracking; customs-duty *calculation* (landed cost allocates amounts that are entered or invoiced); consignment; inter-company; reservation that blocks other documents (commitments are advisory — the negative-stock policy is the only hard stop); fiscalization fields on any document (P7); sales analysis and slow movers (P10 — leave their nav tags); reorder automation, MRP (P12); POS (P11).

## Decisions locked for this phase — implement exactly

1. **Item lines on partner documents.** `partner_document_lines` gains `item_id`, `uom_id`, `base_quantity`, `warehouse_id`, `order_line_id` (SO line for AR, PO line for AP), `grn_line_id` (AP invoice ↔ GRN line), `returns_line_id` (credit note → the invoice line it returns), `kit_parent_line_id`, all nullable; `quantity` stays the keyed quantity in `uom_id`. A GL line (P4 shape) and an item line coexist on one document. The line's `gl_account_id` is resolved by the service for item lines: **AR** → `items.sales_account_id` → the transaction type's default → `gl_settings`; **AP stock item** → the GRN accrual account (decision 5); **AP service / non-stock item** → `items.purchase_account_id` (new, nullable) → the transaction type's default. The revenue or expense journal line of an item line carries `item_id` (P10's sales analysis reads it). Prices default from the item — `selling_price` converted between inclusive and exclusive to the document's `tax_mode`; tax codes default from the item's sales or purchase default. Only stock items move stock; service and non-stock items are ordinary lines with an item dimension.
2. **A stock-bearing partner document posts two entries in one transaction: the partner side (`ar` / `ap`, the P4 posting) and a companion stock entry (`inv`) through the P5 primitives.** The stock side posts first, so its value is known to the partner side. Both link to the document (`source_doc_type='partner_document'`, `source_doc_id`; `partner_documents.stock_entry_id` the other way). The companion draws from a new `STK` sequence (`STK-`), registered with `_ENTRY` as its only claimant — a document with no valued stock line has no companion and claims no number. Posting map, base currency, lines carrying the warehouse's `branch_id`, `item_id` and the line's `project_id`:
   - **AR invoice**, stock line: `issue_stock()` at the average (or the flush) → Dr COGS (`items.cogs_account_id` → `gl_settings.cogs_account_id`) / Cr Inventory. Under `block`, `insufficient_stock` lands on the line's quantity cell and the whole document is refused; under `allow`, the move is `cost_provisional` (P5 decision 5).
   - **AR credit note**, stock line: `receive_stock()` — at the returned invoice line's issued `unit_cost` when `returns_line_id` is set, at the current average otherwise → Dr Inventory / Cr COGS.
   - **AP supplier invoice**, stock line **with** `grn_line_id`: no move — the match (decision 6). **Without** a GRN link: `receive_stock()` at the line's net unit cost converted to base at the document's booking rate → Dr Inventory / Cr GRN accrual, and the partner side's goods line debits the accrual for the same value, so the accrual nets to zero inside the document.
   - **AP return to supplier (debit note)**, stock line: `issue_stock()` at the average (or the flush) → Dr GRN accrual / Cr Inventory; the partner side credits the accrual for exactly the issued value and posts the difference to the credit claimed from the supplier (net line price) as purchase price variance. The accrual nets to zero inside the document; PPV carries the gain or loss.
   - **Reversal** = the P4 document reversal plus `reverse_stock_posting()` on the companion, in that order's mirror, one reversal only; `reverse_document` calls the inventory service for the companion — which opens its own `module_reversal` window — and never opens the `inv` window itself.
3. **Orders are commitments.** `sales_orders` / `sales_order_lines` and `purchase_orders` / `purchase_order_lines`: header carries partner, `order_date`, `expected_date`, reference, currency and booking rate (display only — stock is never valued at the order's rate), branch, project, sales rep and payment terms (SO), `tax_mode`, `warehouse_id` (default for lines; PO: delivery warehouse), status, description, totals as sums of rounded lines; lines carry item (required — orders are about items; free GL lines stay on P4 documents), description, `uom_id`, `quantity` and `base_quantity`, `unit_price`, `discount_percent`, `tax_code_id`, net/tax/gross, `warehouse_id`, `project_id`, `kit_parent_line_id`. Numbers `SO-` / `PO-` from `document_sequences` claimed at creation (an order keeps its number when cancelled — the order tables are the claimants). Orders are editable while open and audited (`audit_log` before/after): a line with fulfilment cannot go below its fulfilled quantity, and partner and currency lock once anything is fulfilled. **Close** cancels the remaining quantities and keeps the history; **Cancel** is allowed only when nothing is fulfilled. Neither posts.
4. **Derived quantities, statuses verified.** Per SO line, `invoiced = Σ base_quantity` of posted, unreversed AR invoice lines carrying its `order_line_id`; per PO line, `received = Σ` of unreversed GRN lines (stock items) or Σ of posted AP invoice lines (service and non-stock items — a service is "received" by its invoice, no GRN); per GRN line, `matched = Σ base_quantity` of posted, unreversed AP invoice lines carrying its `grn_line_id`. `committed(item, warehouse) = Σ (ordered − invoiced)` over open SO lines, `on_order = Σ (ordered − received)` over open PO lines, `available = on_hand − committed`; a reversal changes these by construction. Statuses are stored workflow columns — SO `open | partially_invoiced | invoiced | closed | cancelled`, PO `open | partially_received | received | closed | cancelled`, GRN `received | partially_matched | matched | reversed` — written only by the order service and checked by `verify_order_statuses()` against the derived state, the `open_amount` pattern. No `quantity_*` column that is not a query.
5. **The GRN accrual account is a control account.** New `ControlType.GRN_ACCRUAL` on a new seeded liability account (`2350 Goods Received Not Invoiced`, class liability, postable), `gl_settings.grn_accrual_account_id`; registry rows for `inv` and `ap`; every line on it carries `item_id`; a manual journal against it fails `control_account_direct_posting`. Its balance is therefore provable: **at any date, per branch, accrual balance == Σ over GRN lines of (received value − relieved value)** — the P6 invariant, asserted after every posting test. The landed-cost clearing account (`1370 Landed Cost Clearing`, current asset, `gl_settings.landed_cost_clearing_account_id`) stays a **plain** account: freight arrives as a GL line on a forwarder's supplier invoice, duty as a cashbook payment to RRA, and both must be able to land on it. Its balance == Σ costs booked − Σ allocated, and the acceptance tape drives it to zero. `5300 Purchase Price Variance` is already seeded → `gl_settings.purchase_price_variance_account_id`. Rwanda seed pack plus the back-fill migration for existing tenants, tested the P4/P5 way (`tests/test_p6_backfill.py`: provision at the pre-P6 revision, upgrade, assert every key and account lands non-null).
6. **GRN and the three-way match.** `goods_received_notes` / `goods_received_note_lines`: supplier, optional `purchase_order_id`, warehouse, `grn_date`, supplier delivery-note reference, currency and rate, status; lines carry `purchase_order_line_id` (nullable — a GRN without a PO is a direct receipt with its cost keyed), item, `uom_id`, quantity and `base_quantity`, document-currency unit cost, frozen base `value` = round(base quantity × unit cost × rate at `grn_date`), the move link. Posting a GRN is `receive_stock()` with the accrual as contra; the GRN is the stock document, so its entry takes the GRN's number (`GRN-`; claimants `_ENTRY` + the GRN table, because a zero-cost GRN moves quantity and posts no entry). Against a PO line, `base_quantity` may not exceed the line's remaining quantity (`receipt_exceeds_order`, no tolerance in v1). **Match:** a supplier invoice line with `grn_line_id` relieves the accrual at the GRN line's frozen base value × (matched ÷ received) — rounded half-up, the last match of a line takes the line's remaining relieved value so a fully matched line relieves exactly what it accrued — and posts the difference to the invoice line's base net as PPV. Price *and* rate movements are PPV; FX on the payable itself stays with P4's allocation. An invoice line matches one GRN line; one invoice may carry lines from several GRNs of the same supplier; `matched` may not exceed `received` (`match_exceeds_receipt`). A matched invoice reverses like any P4 document and the GRN line's `matched` falls by construction; a GRN with any matched quantity cannot be reversed (`grn_matched`) — reverse the invoice first; an unmatched GRN reverses through `reverse_stock_posting()` under the negative-stock policy.
7. **Order → document flows.** "Invoice this order" builds an AR invoice from the SO's open lines with `order_line_id` set, defaulting each quantity to the remaining quantity under `allow` and to `min(remaining, available)` under `block`; the user may lower, never raise above remaining (`invoice_exceeds_order`). "Receive" builds a GRN from a PO's open stock lines; "Process invoice" builds a supplier invoice from a GRN's unmatched lines (item, quantity, the GRN unit cost as the default price, the item's purchase tax code) or from a PO's open service lines. Backorder = ordered − fulfilled on an open line; an SO may commit more than is available (`gl_settings.backorder_policy` `allow` default; `block` refuses the order line with `exceeds_available`), and the enquiry, the listing and the line grid all show it.
8. **Kits and Breakup.** `ItemType.KIT` (new enum value; a kit never has a move, is never received, and `kit_not_purchasable` refuses it on the AP side) with `item_kit_components` (kit item → component item, quantity per kit in the component's base unit, line order; components are stock or service items; no nested kits). A kit line on an SO or an AR invoice is stored as the parent line (kit item, quantity, price, tax — the revenue line) plus component lines with `kit_parent_line_id`, quantity = kit quantity × per-kit, no price, no tax, exploded at line entry from the definition. Commitment and COGS come from the component lines; revenue from the parent. **Breakup** (Transactions → Order Entry) is the screen that edits the explosion on an open, not-yet-invoiced kit line of a sales order — quantities and substitutions against the definition's defaults — through `PUT /oe/sales-orders/{id}/lines/{line_id}/breakup`; the same action opens from the line on the order workspace. That is what the plan's "SO-line kit expansion" is; the BOM Breakup under Transactions → BOM stays tagged P12.
9. **Landed cost (Importation Split).** `landed_cost_documents` / `landed_cost_lines`: date, description, reference, base-currency `amount`, `basis` (`value | quantity | weight`), target GRN lines (any supplier, any GRN), optional informational source links (the invoice or cashbook line the cost came from), status, entry link, `LCA-` numbers. Shares = amount × line weight ÷ Σ weights, half-up to base decimals, the rounding residue on the last target line so Σ shares == amount exactly; `weight` basis reads a new nullable `items.weight_per_base_unit` and refuses a target whose item has none (`weight_missing`). Posting: for each target whose item still has quantity at the GRN line's warehouse, `revalue_stock()` with the clearing account as contra (Dr Inventory / Cr Clearing — the P5 zero-quantity move; the average rises from this posting onward and earlier issues are never restated); a target whose location holds none of the item takes its share to COGS instead, on the same entry, so the clearing account clears whether or not the goods are still there. If `revalue_stock()` cannot carry a stockless target line, extend it minimally under its existing tests rather than post a second entry — and say so. Reversal through `reverse_stock_posting()` at the original values.
10. **Settings on the existing mechanism.** New `gl_settings` keys: `grn_accrual_account_id`, `purchase_price_variance_account_id`, `landed_cost_clearing_account_id`, `backorder_policy`. The **Order defaults** screen edits these; SO and PO default their warehouse from `default_warehouse_id`. No second settings store.
11. **Permissions.** The v4-era constants already exist — `oe:setup_manage`, `oe:sales_orders_manage`, `oe:purchase_orders_manage`, `oe:grv_process`, `oe:reports_view` — wire them; add `oe:landed_cost_post`. Back-fill Administrator. Item lines on AR/AP documents stay under the P4 permissions.
12. **Numbering and idempotency.** `SO`, `PO`, `GRN`, `LCA`, `STK` in `DocType` and `DEFAULT_PREFIXES`, each in `SEQUENCE_CLAIMANTS`; `Idempotency-Key` on order create, GRN post, landed-cost post and every partner-document post (existing); breakup save is a PUT.
13. **Events.** Retire the three stubs: goods receipt is `StockReceived` through `receive_stock()`, the match is `PartnerDocumentPosted` with a matched line, `StockSold` becomes the real event class the companion issue posts under (a `StockJournal` with `doc_type=STK`). ADR-05's names are vocabulary, not a promise of one class each; note the mapping in `events.py` where the stubs were.
14. **Currency.** SO and PO carry a currency; an invoice raised from an SO takes the SO's currency and prices and its own dated rate (P4). GRN base value uses the rate at `grn_date`. Companion stock entries are base-currency entries. The accrual line on a match is a base-currency line beside the invoice's document-currency lines — the kernel already allows mixed-currency lines, each with its frozen `base_amount`.

## Build order — commit after each step with green checks

1. **Masters, settings, schema.** Migration: the item-line columns of decision 1, `items.purchase_account_id`, `items.weight_per_base_unit`, `ItemType.KIT`, `item_kit_components`, `ControlType.GRN_ACCRUAL` + registry rows, the four `gl_settings` keys, `partner_documents.stock_entry_id`, `oe:landed_cost_post`; seed `2350` and `1370` (mark `2350` control), settings, the back-fill with `tests/test_p6_backfill.py`; `DocType` entries, prefixes and claimants; Order defaults endpoint (GET/PUT); kit components CRUD on the items service; the api-enums export regenerated (drift gate green). Migration applies from zero, `alembic check` clean, RLS linter green.

2. **Posting contract — partner documents with item lines, GRN, match.** Decision 2 in `app/subledger/documents.py` (one code path; the role × kind matrix grows an item-line branch, not a second service), the accrual guard and dimension rule, GRN create/post/reverse (standalone — the PO link is step 3), the match in the supplier-invoice post with `grn_line_id`. Extend the invariant suite with `assert_order_invariants`: accrual balance == Σ (received − relieved) at any date, per branch; clearing balance == booked − allocated; every stock-bearing document has exactly one companion whose `keyed_moves` correspond 1:1 to its stock lines, or none when no stock line carried value; `matched ≤ received` on every GRN line; `verify_order_statuses()` reports no drift. Hypothesis: random sequences of GRNs, partial matches, direct item invoices, customer and supplier returns and reversals at a 0-dp and a 2-dp base, asserting the whole suite (ledger, subledger, stock, order) after every step. **STOP.** Report the schema, the posting map per (role, kind, item type, link), the accrual proof, the invariant output. Wait for approval before building orders.

3. **Orders.** SO and PO with lines, create/edit/close/cancel, `order_line_id` on invoice lines and `purchase_order_line_id` on GRN lines (this step's migration), the derived quantities of decision 4 as service functions and one SQL view each, statuses + `verify_order_statuses()`, the flows of decision 7 (`POST …/invoice`, `…/receive`, `…/process-invoice` returning a prepared `DocumentInput`, posted by the existing endpoints), `receipt_exceeds_order` / `invoice_exceeds_order` / `exceeds_available`, kits and breakup (decision 8), the item enquiry gaining on order / committed / available per warehouse. Property tests: derived quantities equal a brute-force recomputation after any sequence of orders, fulfilments, reversals and edits; a kit line's components always sum to kit quantity × per-kit unless breakup edited them; an order can never be over-fulfilled.

4. **Landed cost.** Decision 9 end to end, including the stockless-target rule and reversal. Tests: shares always sum to the amount on every basis and at both decimal places; a fully allocated clearing account is zero; an allocation after a partial sale restates nothing earlier.

5. **Enquiries, reports, the acceptance tape — backend.** Sales order and purchase order enquiry endpoints (header, lines with ordered / fulfilled / remaining / backordered, linked documents, drill to journal entries); listings with server pagination and status filters: sales orders, purchase orders, goods received (with matched and unmatched value, and the unmatched total that must equal the accrual balance), landed cost (per GRN line). The item enquiry and the P5 Transaction report drill to the invoice, GRN or landed-cost document for the new source types. Then the **acceptance tape** as a test in the RWF-base company, expected values as literals worked by hand in a comment — never computed by the code under test. Setup: stock item X (selling price 2 000 excl., VAT 18 % both ways), kit K = 2 × X (price 3 500 excl.), warehouse Main, supplier S, forwarder F, customer C, policy `block`, `backorder_policy` `allow`. ## Definition of Done (all must be true)

The acceptance tape reproduces every expected value above to the rounding rule, including the posting-order treatment of a landed cost allocated after a partial sale; `assert_order_invariants` passes, so the GRN accrual account equals Σ unmatched receipts at any date and per branch, and the landed-cost clearing account is zero when everything booked to it is allocated; nothing but `inv` and `ap` can post to the accrual and every such line carries an item; order-to-cash moves stock, COGS and AR through one invoice post and reverses through one action; procure-to-pay works PO → partial GRN → partial match → PPV with price and rate movements; a stock-bearing partner document has exactly one companion entry with one move per stock line; every quantity an order holds is a query; a kit explodes at line entry and Breakup edits it; backorders are visible on the order, the enquiry and the grid; every P6 row in the Appendix C tree — Order defaults, GRV, Purchase order, Sales order, Breakup, Landed cost, the two enquiries, the four reports — is live, untagged, opened by a test with data and shown in a committed screenshot; nothing writes to the ledger outside the PostingEngine; every audited call passes a real actor; every mutating endpoint has a caller; CI green on backend and frontend. Final report: what landed, screenshots of the sales order with a kit line, the GRV in matching mode, the landed-cost preview and the goods-received report with its accrual tie, decisions worth review, and any plan deviations with reasons.
